title: Nonnegative closed-fibre target stalks are vanishing-cycle cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$, and $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'\to S_{(s)}$ geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Put $X'=X\times_SS_{(s)}$, $p:X'\to X$, $f':X'\to S_{(s)}$, and let $i:X_s\to X'$ and $h:X_t\to X'$ be the canonical closed-fibre and $t$-fibre projections [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality]. For any geometric $z$ of $X_s$, put $x=p\circ i\circ z$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. There exists $e:S_{(s)}\simeq S_{(f\circ x)}$ such that, for every $q\in\mathbb N$, the $z$-stalk of $\mathcal H^q(i^{-1}Rh_*h^{-1}(p^{-1}G[0]))$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is isomorphic to $H^q(V_{f,x,e\circ t},G|_V)$ [def-weil-pbc-local-acyclicity-abelian-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Here $G|_V$ is inverse image along $V_{f,x,e\circ t}\to X_{(x)}\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No local acyclicity is assumed.

proof.text: The map t is a morphism between affine schemes and hence affine. Its base change h is affine, thus quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The pullback condition for i supplies the closed-point factorization needed by the strict-fibre comparison.

proof.text: Commute homology with exact inverse image along i and compare the z-stalk with the iz-stalk. Commute the exact inverse image along h with the single functor. Apply the unrestricted strict-henselization stalk formula for h to h⁻¹p⁻¹G in degree q. The upstream unrestricted formula uses strictLocalization and strictLocalizationToBase rather than the small representative colimit model.

The symmetry and pullbackRightPullbackFstIso identify X_t×_(X′)X′_(iz) with X′_(iz)×_(S′)Spec Ω′. Compose with the strict-fibre comparison; its projection equation proves equality of maps to X. theorem closedFibre_derivedUnit_target_stalks
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
    (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s)
    {Ξ : Type u} [Field Ξ] [IsAlgClosed Ξ]
    (z : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶
      pullback (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Scheme.strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))) :
    let p := pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
    let f' := pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
    let i := pullback.fst f' (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Scheme.strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))
    let h := pullback.fst f' t
    let x := (z ≫ i) ≫ p
    ∃ e : Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s ≅ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme (x ≫ f),
      ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((Scheme.pointSmallEtale z).sheafFiber.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj
              ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
                (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
                  (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).rightDerivedFunctorPlus).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
                    ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj G))))) ≅
          (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (localAcyclicityFiber f x (t ≫ e.hom)) (q : ℤ)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (pullback.fst (localAcyclicityStrictMap f x) (t ≫ e.hom) ≫
                  Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x)).obj G)))
